mechanism: Dronedarone inhibits CYP3A4, reducing colchicine metabolism and increasing colchicine plasma concentrations, elevating risk of colchicine toxicity including myopathy and gastrointestinal toxicity.
action: Reduce colchicine dose by 50% or consider alternative antibiotic; monitor for colchicine toxicity symptoms including muscle weakness, diarrhea, and nausea; avoid combination in renal/hepatic impairment.
